description: Balance top-up for a user of the merchant's own service (AI service, SaaS, website): a QR invoice whose metadata is { ref: userRef, pack, qutpay_kind: "topup" }. The merchant keeps the balance in their own system and credits it on the invoice.paid webhook (idempotent by invoice id; subtract on invoice.refunded). Qut Pay holds no balance. Not for digital goods inside Telegram bots (Telegram requires Stars there). Returns payUrl like qutpay_create_invoice.

amount.description: Amount in KZT; packs from 1 000 KZT make sense because of the Kaspi fee

description.description: Shown to the customer; default "Баланс толтыру"

pack.description: Pack id or label, e.g. "pro-600" — returned in metadata.pack

userRef.description: Your user id to credit: 1–64 chars, A–Z a–z 0–9 _ . : -

name: qutpay_create_topup
title: Create a balance top-up invoice
